name: changeable-pricing-section

frames.best_why: Shows the monthly prices with Team selected and its feature list unfolded, plus the billing switch.

tagline: Plan picker with a monthly/yearly switch and features that unfold when picked.
summary: A compact pricing card listing three plans as radio rows. A Monthly/Yearly switch springs across, prices roll, and the chosen plan expands to show its feature list.
appearance: A dark rounded panel holds a Select a plan heading, a small segmented Monthly/Yearly switch and three stacked plan rows. Each row has a radio dot, plan name, description and a right-aligned price.
behaviour: Clicking the switch slides an orange pill and rolls each price to the other billing period. Selecting a plan fills its radio, tints its border orange and unfolds a dashed-top list of features inside that row.
demo_content: Plans Starter, Team and Enterprise priced $12, $29 and $79 monthly with a Popular badge on Team.
search_phrases: select a plan card with features
choose a plan and see features
use_when: A signup flow needs a compact plan chooser with billing period and inline feature detail.
avoid_when: Prices are strings supplied per plan, so discounts and currency maths must be computed outside.
customise: Plans arrive as an array with monthly and yearly price strings, features and badges; title, labels, footer and button text are props.
weight_why: A few plan rows with layout and price animations; no animation loop.

a11y.note: Plan rows are clickable divs with no radio role or keyboard focus, and the toggle has no aria-pressed state.

issues: Plan rows are clickable divs, so keyboard users cannot change the selected plan.
polish_why: Neat dark plan picker with a springy toggle and a tidy feature reveal.
